s01.text: Your Wi-Fi is not slow. It's waiting.

s02.text: Four devices, one channel, and one ten dollar smart plug.

s03.text: It sits at the far end of the house, so it talks slowly. One megabit.

s04.text: You'd think that costs you almost nothing. It doesn't.

s05.text: Wi-Fi doesn't share speed. It shares time.

s06.text: A fast device sends a packet in half a millisecond. The plug needs forty.

s07.text: And while the plug is talking, the channel is busy. Everyone waits.

s08.text: Four percent of the data. Eighty percent of the airtime.

s09.text: That's why walking closer to the router doesn't help.

s10.text: Your router isn't out of bandwidth. It's out of silence.

s11.text: Turn on airtime fairness. Or move the plug to two point four gigahertz.

s12.text: The full breakdown is eleven minutes. It's on the channel.
